name: burstpoint-physics-shorts-engine
description: AI-Guided Physics Simulation & Automated Shorts Production Engine

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const root = path.resolve(__dirname); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let rel = req.url.split('?')[0].replace(/^\//, ''); if (!rel) rel = 'index.html'; let p = path.resolve(root, rel); if (!p.startsWith(root)) { res.writeHead(403); res.end('Forbidden'); return; } if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()) { const ext = path.extname(p); const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json' }; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[ext] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }); server.listen(8080, '127.0.0.1', () => { console.log('Studio running at http://127.0.0.1:8080'); exec('start http://127.0.0.1:8080'); });"
scripts.test:all: node test/simulation.test.js && node test/four_games_adapter.test.js && node test/publishing_scheduler.test.js && node test/youtube_publisher.test.js && node test/qualification_harness.js

author: Burstpoint
